approach: Classical Laminate Theory architecture with explicit material-card inputs

load_case.initial_supported_case: uniaxial tensile load when Nx > 0 and other components are zero
load_case.load_magnitude_policy: must be supplied by user/config; repository does not invent design loads

implemented_equations.Q: orthotropic reduced stiffness matrix under plane stress
implemented_equations.Qbar: standard transformed reduced stiffness matrix for each ply angle
implemented_equations.ply_stress: global and local ply strain/stress calculated at ply mid-surface

failure_criterion.missing_allowables_policy: return failure_evaluation_available=false and do not return fabricated failure index

optimization_status.reason: No verified complete lamina material card, strength allowables, or load case exists in repository.
required_before_enable: defined load case magnitude and constraints
validated objective such as minimize Maximum Stress failure index or maximize allowable load factor

separation_from_ann.ann_system: material/process tensile-strength predictor using seven original features
separation_from_ann.clt_system: sequence-aware mechanics evaluator using material card, stacking sequence, and load case
separation_from_ann.policy: Do not feed stacking_sequence into current ANN and do not claim ANN learned ply orientation.

limitations: No repository dataset currently provides complete orthotropic lamina properties.
CLT evaluator can run only when caller supplies explicit material-card values.
Failure evaluation is unavailable when strength allowables are missing.
Optimization remains disabled until verified material data and objective exist.
